source.name: Pipedrive Integration for Dynamics 365 Business Central

mapping.summary: Syncs Pipedrive CRM contacts and deals into BC customers and sales orders.
claims: Pipedrive organizations and persons become BC contacts and customers from a chosen template
Sales orders created when a deal is won, created or hits a set stage
Deal products become order lines, in the deal currency
Never changes released, shipped or invoiced orders
Writes BC customer, contact and order numbers back to Pipedrive
Pushes invoiced, accrued and total revenue per deal to Pipedrive
Sends BC items to Pipedrive as products with category and price
Near-real-time webhook sync or scheduled Job Queue sync per entity
Webhook log with reasons and one-click retry
Per-company settings with configuration export and import
Deleting actions locked until an admin unlocks them
Permission sets for read-only, users, admins and a webhook service account
Supports Pipedrive API v1 and v2
